blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City is ready to host the opening of the Governor’s Cup Under-18 basketball tournament this Sunday at the Mandaue City Sports Complex, with city offices preparing for the arrival of teams from 44 local government units (LGUs) across Cebu. Mandaue City Sports Office head Mary Joy Tabal-Jimenez said the city’s Under-18 team has undergone tryouts, additional player selections, daily training sessions and tune-up games in preparation for the tournament. More than 100 young basketball players joined the initial tryouts, prompting the sports office to hold additional selections to finalize the roster. The city government has provided […]...
